topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't believe they're going through with this. A fence, right on the property line. Years we've shared this space, this open space between our homes—it's been like an unspoken agreement. Now, my neighbor comes along, talking about privacy and boundaries. I've tried talking to them, explaining how this changes everything, but they seem set. It's not just about the fence; it's the message it sends. I don’t know how to make them see the value of what we had. I keep thinking there must be a way to stop this, to keep things as they are. But the posts are already going in, and there's nothing I can do.
